sources.rights_policy: Public author-owned correspondence; retain source attribution and canonical archive URL. No redistribution license is asserted.
sources.boundary: The archive spans many years. Each run discovers only the archive index and fetches at most eight linked public messages; this is intentionally not a bulk email mirror.
sources.notes: Google Groups is the current official home. gnusha.org is the long-lived public archive linked by the Bitcoin development archive transition page and provides stable, fetchable message pages.

sources.rights_policy: Public forum posts remain author-owned unless a post states otherwise. Store a local research snapshot with attribution; no redistribution license is asserted.
sources.boundary: The full Discourse archive is large and mutable. A run ingests at most ten topics from the public latest-topic API, including their public posts.
sources.notes: Uses Discourse's public JSON endpoints and preserves topic URLs and post authors.

sources.rights_policy: Public research material remains copyrighted by its authors unless the source states a license. The snapshot records attribution and does not assert redistribution rights.
sources.boundary: Only same-site research links exposed by the public landing page and two known public paper URLs are considered, capped at ten items.
sources.notes: PDF text extraction is attempted with pdftotext when installed; otherwise the PDF is retained and indexed by provenance metadata.

sources.rights_policy: Public resources remain copyrighted by Fairgate or named authors unless an item states a license. No redistribution license is asserted.
sources.boundary: The public resource hub is sampled to at most ten same-site resources per run; external links and marketing pages are excluded.
sources.notes: The public Fairgate whitepaper is a pinned seed so discovery remains useful if the resource hub is client-rendered.

sources.rights_policy: Public articles remain copyrighted by Alpen Labs or named authors unless an item states a license. No redistribution license is asserted.
sources.boundary: The official blog contains research and non-research material. The fetcher takes at most ten public blog posts and records that topical review is still required.
sources.notes: The two pinned research posts provide deterministic coverage if the blog index is client-rendered.

sources.rights_policy: Public papers and articles remain copyrighted by Babylon Labs or named authors unless an item states a license. No redistribution license is asserted.
sources.boundary: The site and documentation set are broad. Three public papers are pinned and official blog discovery is capped so a run fetches at most ten items.
sources.notes: PDF text extraction is attempted locally; source PDFs and checksums remain available even when extraction tooling is absent.

sources.rights_policy: No repository LICENSE or COPYING file was detected at the pinned commit. No reuse or redistribution license is asserted; individual file notices, if any, continue to apply.
sources.boundary: Only documentation, license material, and text source/script files are considered, capped at thirty files; Git history and binary artifacts are excluded.
sources.notes: Public Git transport is used instead of web-page crawling. The exact commit is locked in this registry and every document records repository, commit, and path.

sources.rights_policy: No repository LICENSE or COPYING file was detected at the pinned commit. No reuse or redistribution license is asserted; individual file notices, if any, continue to apply.
sources.boundary: Only scripts/opcodes plus top-level documentation/license files are considered, capped at forty files; the rest of bitvm-js and Git history are excluded.
sources.notes: Public Git transport is used instead of web-page crawling. The commit is pinned and canonical links use immutable blob URLs.

sources.rights_policy: Public gists have no implied open-source license. Preserve author, canonical gist URL, revision, and filename; no redistribution license is asserted unless a gist states one.
sources.boundary: At most ten current public gists and twenty total files are fetched through the unauthenticated public GitHub API; history beyond the pinned current revision is not mirrored.
sources.notes: GitHub API access is rate-limited and is not a robots-based web crawl. Each gist's current history revision is recorded.

sources.rights_policy: Public documentation remains copyrighted by Citrea or named authors unless a page states a license. No redistribution license is asserted.
sources.boundary: Documentation is broad and changes over time. Only twelve same-host pages linked directly from the public documentation entry page are retained per run.
sources.notes: Robots is checked before discovery and before every page request; inaccessible or disallowed pages are recorded as skips.
